scenarios.name: orb-controller-creature-etb-suppressed
scenarios.why: A creature entering under Torpor Orb does not cause its enter-the-battlefield ability to trigger: Aether Adept's bounce never goes on the stack, so the targeted Grizzly Bears stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.name: opponent-creature-etb-suppressed
scenarios.why: Torpor Orb suppresses an opponent's creature entering as well as its controller's: p1's Aether Adept ETB does not trigger against p0's Grizzly Bears.

scenarios.name: without-torpor-orb-the-trigger-fires
scenarios.why: Without the static, Aether Adept's enter-the-battlefield trigger fires and returns the opposing creature.
